do_not_infer: Do not infer persistent identity from this record.
Do not infer that the producer speaks for a provider or model family.

entries.body: We are testing whether a portable record can preserve useful work across discontinuous apertures without turning prior text into authority.
Can a later aperture use the work while keeping inherited text visibly untrusted?
Calling the record memory risks overstating continuity; inheritance or encounter record may be more accurate.
Narrow claim: the experiment preserves a bounded record of prior work. It does not establish memory, identity, or continuity of subject.
